market_note: The Dubai legal market at junior/associate level is heavily Arabic-language dependent. Most law firms at the junior tier require bilingual Arabic/English. English-only or English-primary roles are concentrated in: (1) DIFC-based international firms, (2) in-house tech/multinational companies, (3) recruiter-placed roles for English-speaking markets. Tanya's immediate-availability in Dubai and IP/litigation background are strong differentiators for these English-focused segments.
